rules.statement: A property gifted by deed remains subject to the terms and conditions specified in the deed, and a Registrar of Lands may refuse registration if the recipient does not comply with those terms.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) When N gifted the property by P1 she gifted the property to the 2nd petitioner and the Maha Sanga as Sangika property as per the deed; as the 2nd petitioner derived his title from deed P1 the respondent Registrar of Lands could refuse to register the said deed under section 36(1 )(a).
